influences.name: George Lee's father
influences.context: My dad has been in a band my whole life and when I was a kid, he'd have band practice in our garage growing up. My dad and his mates were absolute rock stars to me and I think being around such a musical atmosphere at such a young age got me immediately hooked on the idea of being involved in it for my career... If It wasn't for my dad's practice, I doubt I'd have been influenced as much to pursue music.
